description: Whole chains and whether the reference accepts them. Each case is a chain.json-shaped document (doc), the consensus constants it needs, and the verdicts: expect_valid is is_valid() with the full proof-of-work re-check; expect_valid_without_pow_recheck is the same without recomputing matmul proofs of work (everything cheap is still checked). Every 'rule:' case is a validly mined block that breaks exactly one rule, on top of a prefix that is valid by itself. The timestamp rule depends on the validator's clock, so the timestamps used are far in the past (or, for the future-timestamp case, in the year 2100).
name: chains
